headlineOfDay: Nvidia's turmoil after Jensen Huang's exit drags tech shares down, as Ukraine cripples the Crimea bridge and Trump heads into Asian summits.

markets.summary: US stocks fell sharply, with the Nasdaq down 2.5% and the S&P 500 down 1.9%, as investors turned cautious ahead of Nvidia's results. European and UK shares also slid about 1%, with Deutsche Bank hit by a data leak. Oil edged higher on the day despite glut fears, while the 10-year Treasury yield stayed above 5%.

commodities.label: Brent crude
commodities.note: Brent rose on the day, though crude is down sharply over the month on global glut forecasts despite attacks on vessels near Hormuz.

rates_fx.label: US 10Y yield
rates_fx.note: The 10-year yield remains above 5%, and strategists are watching how it affects earnings growth.
